command: node --import tsx --test tests/adventure.test.ts tests/api.test.ts tests/game.test.ts tests/survival.test.ts

checks.name: old survival v2 saves migrate combat, food, equipment and Pulse state without losing progress
weapons consume materials and equip; damage, cooldown, drops and XP are genuine and one-time
enemy AI approaches, telegraphs damage, respects dodge and pauses after death
Root Warden can be defeated with normal attacks and its quest can be claimed exactly once
skills spend earned points, alter stats and cave unlock requires real progress and tools
food declines only during active simulation; eating restores food, health and stamina
Pulse establishes a baseline, emits one event per NEW confirmed height, ignores duplicates and optimistic blocks
Pulse backlog is bounded, catches up without skipping heights and survives imported older saves
all four real-block world encounter types are playable and reward only once after refresh
accepted real measurement schema parses; missing provenance remains unknown; receipt XP cannot replay
live panel never converts unavailable or stale measurements to zero; preserves all provenance types
retired Pulse receipts cannot be resurrected by importing an old save after journal pruning
safe snapshots below a previously confirmed target cannot emit unconfirmed backlog heights
bark armor reduces telegraphed combat damage without consuming inventory
all eight captured real API responses pass the application validators
unavailable is an error and is never interpreted as empty or zero
rejects wrong chain, version, deployment and unsafe event provenance
rejects impossible settlement ranges
formats large blockchain integers without float precision loss
daily rewards are idempotent and reset on UTC date boundaries
XP, levels and achievements derive from earned quest receipts
damaged, unknown-version and malformed browser storage recover safely
movement reaches its destination without skipping tiles and stays in bounds
bounded discovery history preserves lifetime XP and unlocked achievements
survival save round-trips world, inventory, costs, position, quests, settings and runs
previous project saves retain names, XP, achievements, preferences and foraging records
movement is smooth, normalized diagonally, and sprint spends real stamina
collision prevents water, walls, tree trunks, burrow and boundaries from being crossed
actual movement follows collision-aware paths to every exit and every resource node
gathering checks range, tool, cooldown, stamina and capacity without losing resources
recipes consume exact costs atomically, tools equip once, and advanced crafting needs home
build and upgrade all four structures use exact costs and apply actual benefits
campfires heal and gardens require 90 active seconds and capacity before harvesting
consumables, item drops, thorn damage and safe respawn preserve the expected supplies
travel is proximity gated, bidirectional and discovery XP is earned only once
daily quest claims are gated, idempotent and roll over without losing lifetime XP
hidden rewards can be collected once, and do not vanish when inventory is full
foraging minigame credits actual seeds, bounds history and grants daily XP only on claim
